outcome: Term delivery of a healthy baby
cohort: A 35-year-old woman diagnosed with heterotopic interstitial pregnancy after IVF and embryo transfer.
finding: Laparoscopic excision and curettage successfully managed a heterotopic interstitial pregnancy, leading to a healthy term delivery.
mod_finding: The healthy baby was delivered at term by cesarean section.
gest_age: The baby was delivered at term gestational age.
